app_fee.value: Non-refundable application fee of CAD 125 per program, paid by credit card after you submit.
app_fee.quote: After you submit your application you will be required to pay the non-refundable application fee of C$125

fee_waiver.value: Carleton does not waive graduate application fees.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fees for graduate programs will not be waived

gre_general.value: Graduate Studies sets no GRE rule; see each program record.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT taken on or after 21 January 2026: 4.5 overall (5.0 writing; 4.5 reading, listening, speaking). Tests taken before then: 86 (20 reading/listening, 22 speaking/writing). Some programs set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026: | 4.5 overall (minimum 5.0 in writing, 4.5 in reading, listening and speaking) | For exams taken before January 21, 2026: | 86 (20 in reading and listening; 22 in speaking and writing)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each band; One-Skill Retake accepted.

english_waiver.value: The waiver covers only degrees from countries whose primary language is English (or a recent Canadian degree), and medium-of-instruction letters are explicitly not accepted, so Indian applicants should plan on a test.
english_waiver.quote: presenting official certification (transcripts) that you have completed an undergraduate or graduate degree at a university in any country in which the primary language is English | Note: Letters from your universities stating the medium of instruction is English are not acceptable.

notes: Most programs have two deadlines per term; the first guarantees consideration for admission and funding. Applicants from outside Canada are advised to finish applying five to six months before the start date for visa arrangements.
